text: The future of AI is both exciting and uncertain. Today we have "narrow" AI, which is good at one task, like translation. Experts are now working on artificial general intelligence (AGI) – a machine that can think like a human. This could bring huge benefits, such as solving medical problems or helping with education. However, there are serious risks too, like job losses or safety issues. Predictions about when AGI will arrive differ a lot: some say ten years, others think it may never happen. Most people agree that we need clear rules to make sure AI helps society.
